title: ephemerantha quadriloba
intro: Ephemerantha quadriloba, commonly known as the 'Horned Passions Flower', is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ephemerantha quadriloba include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which can aid in promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
